content.title: EVGO Q3 CY2025 Deep Dive: Revenue Growth Driven by Network Expansion and Operational Leverage
content.summary: Electric vehicle charging company EVgo (NASDAQ:EVGO) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 36.7% year on year to $92.3 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $377.5 million at the midpoint came in 2.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.02 per share was 81.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
